text.tspan: The robot starts at the center of the rectangle arena facing right
It moves forward until its front sensors detect an obstacle
Once again it moves forward until the front sensors detect an obstacle
It slowly keeps turning clockwise until its left sensor detects the obstacle
Finally it drives forward with some obstacle avoidance logic
As soon as there is no obstacle at the left it stops moving and waits forever
